# `compat/healers/lifecycle-healer.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/healers/lifecycle-healer.js`

healers/lifecycle-healer.js — ensure lifecycle healing flags are populated. These flags drive the interposers and the recovery layer (Phase 7): whether to recover on GPU context loss, namespace storage, and route downloads safely.

## Functions

### `healLifecycle({ profile }, report)`

healers/lifecycle-healer.js — ensure lifecycle healing flags are populated. These flags drive the interposers and the recovery layer (Phase 7): whether to recover on GPU context loss, namespace storage, and route downloads safely.
